Gears giving you grief?

The useful detail is what happens, not a guessed diagnosis. Tell Clive which gear or driving condition brings the problem on, whether it changes when the truck warms up, and when you first noticed it.

A noise, warning or change in shifting does not establish the cause on its own. The truck and transmission details help Clive discuss the assessment and whether the job is suitable.

Bring the right details to the call

  • Truck make, model, registration and transmission type if known.
  • The exact symptom, such as hard selection, unusual noise or loss of drive.
  • Whether the issue happens under load, while changing gear or at a standstill.
  • Recent repairs, service history and any visible warning message.
  • Your location and whether the truck can be accessed safely.

Assessment before repair decisions

Discuss inspection, removal, repair or rebuilding requirements directly with Clive. The right approach depends on the component, fault and condition. Parts, labour, timing and any further work should be discussed before a booking or repair is approved.

For work on a removed assembly, read about component rebuilding. For a truck stopped on the road, use the field service enquiry page.

Victoria wide enquiries

Have your suburb, postcode or nearest town ready. Clive will confirm travel, timing and availability for your truck.
